item.title: Curry gets candid in Ayesha's getaway post, paddling Canadian blue waters
item.summary: Stephen Curry and Ayesha Curry offered fans a glimpse of their peaceful kayaking getaway in Desolation Sound, British Columbia. Ayesha shared playful selfies and a short video from the water, while Stephen paddled behind her. The outing comes weeks after the couple celebrated their 15th wedding anniversary, highlighting the relaxed family and relationship moments they continue to make time for away from Stephen’s NBA career.
